name: Henkaku Haven High School Rumble
source: The director of reF00d, rePatch and LOLIcon join forces with HH-Vita and Vitacord main developer to bring you a story of love and total betrayal. The only way it could offer a more vita experience is if there was no game at all.
translation: 《reF00d》《rePatch》和《LOLIcon》的导演，与《HH-Vita》和《Vitacord》的主要开发者联手，为你带来一段关于爱情与彻底背叛的故事。想要拥有更“Vita”的体验，唯一办法就是根本没有这款游戏。
